items.question: Фаза 5 (UI) на TypeScript — какой фреймворк рендера? Жёсткое ограничение: страницы обязаны открываться из file://, где fetch() локального JSON запрещён CORS, значит данные вшиваются в HTML на build-time. Это статический генератор, не SPA — и это сужает выбор сильнее, чем обычно.
items.default: Preact + preact-render-to-string + esbuild: build-time SSR в self-contained HTML, ~3 КБ рантайма на островки интерактива (фильтр, обратный отсчёт, переоценка свежести)

items.question: GSL-97 needs the Library to cross-index reviews / research / RCA (PRD R5.2). None of the three were indexed at all — library_index() globbed only digests/handoffs/dev_history/reports/prd, so docs/reviews (9 files), docs/research (11) and every incident post-mortem were invisible to the dashboard. Serving them adds REQUIRED fields to the render bundle. Bump the schema, or leave the shelves unindexed?
items.default: bump gosleep.lab.render/4 -> /5 and reshape library into declared sections (four places at once: chronicler.py, render.tsx, types.ts, smoke.sh)

items.question: C5 denylist collides with the ONLY source of a worker's name: data.raw.teammate_name in the event log. How to read it without killing the safety check?
items.default: Exempt exactly the literal 'teammate_name' from the C5 denylist (a read-only JSON key), keep every other form of every denied word banned, and add a self-test asserting the exemption stays narrow (a fixture with 'teammate.spawned' must still be rejected).

last.question: GSL-96 (Jira description) requires GitHub issue links and an epic->PR rollup. Neither is derivable in the view layer from render_bundle schema/3, so the data layer (chronicler.py) must grow: gh issue list + epic membership from git topology, schema /3 -> /4. The cycle brief said 'do not touch chronicler.py'. Proceed?
last.decision: schema render/3 → render/4 bump; C5 = денилист слов не файлов; already merged в GSL-96
